'''Arverne''' is a neighborhood in the [[New York City]] [[Boroughs of New York City|borough]] of [[Queens]], on the [[Rockaway, Queens|Rockaway Peninsula]]. It was initially developed by [[Remington Vernam (land developer)|Remington Vernam]], whose signature "R. Vernam" inspired the name of the neighborhood.<ref>{{cite news |title=On the Beach, a Brand New Life |first=Jeff |last=Vandam |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2005/02/13/nyregion/thecity/13arve.html |newspaper=[[The New York Times]] |date=February 13, 2005 |access-date=October 2, 2007 |quote=His wife names the area Arverne because he signs his checks ''R. Vernam'' |archive-date=May 7, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140507013259/http://www.nytimes.com/2005/02/13/nyregion/thecity/13arve.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Arverne extends from Beach 54th Street to Beach 79th Street, along its main thoroughfare [[Beach Channel Drive]], alternatively known as Rev. Joseph H. May Drive.

Arverne is located in [[Queens Community Board 14|Queens Community District 14]] and its ZIP Code is 11692.<ref name="NYCPlanning"/> It is patrolled by the [[New York City Police Department]]'s 100th Precinct.
